_schema_note: Canonical model catalog per docs/MODEL_GOVERNANCE_STANDARD.md. maturity is the HONEST current claim, checked by tools/validate_model_inventory.py against actual repo evidence (registered oracle checks, Sources/Checks sheets, model_card.md, validation.md, instance count) -- not aspirational. state='template' means the workbook ships with placeholder/zero inputs (Tier 3 by governance definition: no claim of production readiness); state='instance' means a specific populated workbook exists. risk_tier is the DESIGN-INTENT tier for a real populated use of this archetype, per the Tier 1/2/3 definitions in the standard -- it is not a claim that the current blank template is being used for a live decision.

domains.name: Integrated 3-Statement / DCF (BASE archetype)
domains.purpose: Integrated income statement / balance sheet / cash flow with a DCF valuation.
known_limitations: Single populated instance, not two (M4 gate)
No Sources/Checks sheet or model card/validation record yet (M3 gate)
No trading comps or precedent-transaction cross-check on the DCF output

domains.name: LBO (multi-tranche debt, Base/Downside scenarios)
domains.purpose: LBO sources & uses, multi-tranche debt schedule with absolute-priority cash sweep, management promote, Base/Downside scenario switch.
known_limitations: Single populated instance, not two (M4 gate)
No Sources/Checks sheet or model card/validation record yet (M3 gate)
No independent effective-challenge record on file

domains.name: Private Credit / Direct Lending
domains.purpose: Direct-lending credit analysis: leverage, coverage, covenant headroom, Excess Cash Flow sweep with a leverage-based step-down grid.
known_limitations: Single tranche only -- no multi-tranche (first lien/second lien/unitranche) cascade
ECF sweep tier thresholds/percentages are illustrative defaults, not any specific credit agreement's actual terms
No PIK-toggle or covenant-cure mechanics
No populated instance yet (M4 gate)

domains.name: Public Finance (DSA + revenue bond coverage)
domains.purpose: Sovereign/municipal debt sustainability analysis and revenue-bond debt-service coverage / additional bonds test.
known_limitations: Single instrument only -- does not model a full debt portfolio with staggered maturities
Level debt service (PMT) only -- no capital-appreciation or non-level new-issuance structures
No populated instance yet (M4 gate)

domains.name: Asset Management (fund performance)
domains.purpose: TVPI/DPI/RVPI, net IRR to LPs, and a whole-fund (European) GP carry waterfall with clawback.
known_limitations: Whole-fund/European waterfall only -- no deal-by-deal/American structure
Periodic IRR (evenly-spaced periods), not XIRR with real dates
No populated instance yet (M4 gate)

domains.name: Risk Management (portfolio VaR)
domains.purpose: Correlation-weighted portfolio VaR with Euler-theorem component VaR.
known_limitations: No Sources/Checks sheet or model card/validation record yet (M3 gate)
Parametric VaR only -- no historical or Monte Carlo cross-check

domains.name: Trade Finance
domains.purpose: Financing-cost comparison across LC, factoring, and revolver.
known_limitations: Financing-cost comparison added but never independently verified
No supply-chain-finance / dynamic-discounting mechanic

domains.name: Microfinance
domains.purpose: Loan-loss provisioning (PAR aging buckets), portfolio growth, loan-officer productivity, OSS/FSS sustainability, and flat-rate vs. declining-balance true cost of credit.
known_limitations: No group-lending/joint-liability mechanics (a core classic-microfinance risk-sharing structure)
Bisection solve assumes a monthly-equivalent compounding period for the annualized-rate conversion
No populated instance yet (M4 gate)

domains.name: Venture Capital (exit waterfall)
domains.purpose: Exit proceeds waterfall across pref stack and as-converted regimes.
known_limitations: No Sources/Checks sheet or model card/validation record yet (M3 gate)
No participating-preferred-with-cap or multi-round dilution mechanic

domains.name: Options & Derivatives
domains.purpose: Black-Scholes pricing, implied-volatility solver, American option binomial tree (CRR).
known_limitations: No Sources/Checks sheet or model card/validation record yet (M3 gate)
No Greeks (delta/gamma/vega/theta) sheet

domains.name: Commodities
domains.purpose: Physical/financial commodity exposure, basis analysis, hedging, and cost-of-carry / implied convenience yield.
known_limitations: Uses front-month futures price as a spot proxy rather than a true independent spot input
Storage cost assumed constant/annualized -- no seasonal storage-cost curve
No populated instance yet (M4 gate)

domains.name: Crypto / Digital Assets
domains.purpose: Token economics: comp ratios, supply emission/dilution, staking yield, and perpetual-futures funding-rate carry.
known_limitations: Funding rate simplified to the pure premium (omits the small clamped interest-rate component real venues add)
Emission schedule is flat, not the real cliff+linear per-allocation unlock schedule
No populated instance yet (M4 gate)

domains.name: Real Estate / REIT
domains.purpose: 5-year levered hold, exit, IRR/MOIC, DSCR.
known_limitations: Levered-hold mechanic added but never independently verified
No LP/GP promote waterfall

domains.name: Insurance / Actuarial
domains.purpose: Chain-ladder and Bornhuetter-Ferguson loss reserving.
known_limitations: No Sources/Checks sheet or model card/validation record yet (M3 gate)
No stochastic reserving (Mack method / bootstrap) for a reserve range, only point estimates

domains.name: Structured Finance / Securitization
domains.purpose: CDR-driven pool cash flows and two-directional tranche cascade with WAL.
known_limitations: No Sources/Checks sheet or model card/validation record yet (M3 gate)
No prepayment-vector (PSA) sensitivity table

domains.name: Project Finance
domains.purpose: Non-recourse project debt sizing, sculpted debt repayment, and a Debt Service Reserve Account (DSRA) modeling the real payment-default-vs-distribution-lockup distinction.
known_limitations: Sculpting assumes a reliable CFADS forecast -- an optimistic forecast under-reserves real repayment capacity
5-year operating window may not fully retire debt raised against a longer tenor (balloon shown explicitly, not hidden)
No populated instance yet (M4 gate)

domains.name: Fixed Income / Rates
domains.purpose: Bond pricing/duration and accrued interest across day-count conventions.
known_limitations: No Sources/Checks sheet or model card/validation record yet (M3 gate)
No yield-curve bootstrapping or convexity

domains.name: Quantitative / Systematic
domains.purpose: Strategy performance: max drawdown, beta/alpha vs. benchmark.
known_limitations: Drawdown/beta mechanic added but never independently verified
No factor-exposure regression or autocorrelation-adjusted significance

domains.name: Fintech / Payments
domains.purpose: Payments/fintech unit economics, cohort retention, fraud/chargeback risk, and Durbin-regulated vs. exempt interchange economics.
known_limitations: Interchange rates are illustrative approximations of published schedules, not a specific card program's actual contracted rates
No populated instance yet (M4 gate)

domains.name: Distressed / Restructuring
domains.purpose: Fulcrum security identification across the capital structure.
known_limitations: Fulcrum-security computation added but never independently verified
No recovery-waterfall sensitivity across enterprise-value scenarios
